store.summary: Minimal native Rust 3D FPV tinywhoop simulator with USB-C & BT controller support.
store.description: StickZero is a lightweight, zero-dependency 3D FPV quadcopter simulator written in pure Rust for the M5Stack CardputerZero. Inspired by StickTime-Pi, it renders directly to the 320x170 ST7789v3 RGB565 display at 60 FPS with a two-pass 16-bit Z-buffer and 240 Hz 6-DOF quaternion physics. Features BetaFPV Air75 II (75mm) and Meteor75 Pro II (1S 75mm) presets, a dedicated real-unit Drone Tuning menu (Weight (g), Thrust (g), Air Drag, Rotor Grip, Motor Lag (ms), Thr Mid/Expo, Lava II 580/680mAh packs, Prop Wash), ACRO/HORIZON/ANGLE flight modes, custom Betaflight Actual rates, Betaflight OSD with trailing stick overlay & post-flight stats, Monokai & StickTime UI themes, real-time tinywhoop audio, 4 tracks, and USB-C/Bluetooth Stick Calibration & AUX Switch Binding wizards.
